research_question: In adults with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF, LVEF ≥ 50%), do SGLT2 inhibitors compared to placebo reduce cardiovascular mortality and heart failure hospitalization over 12 months?

In patients undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) for acute coronary syndrome, does a short-term dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT) duration (1–3 months) followed by P2Y12 inhibitor monotherapy compared to standard 12-month DAPT reduce major bleeding without increasing major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE)?

In adults with severe asymptomatic aortic stenosis, does early elective aortic valve replacement (AVR) compared with conservative clinical watch-and-wait management decrease all-cause mortality at 2 years?

In patients with persistent atrial fibrillation, does catheter ablation (radiofrequency or cryoballoon) compared with standard antiarrhythmic drug therapy reduce all-cause mortality and stroke recurrence over 24 months?

[Diagnostic] What is the diagnostic test accuracy of coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) compared with invasive coronary angiography (fractional flow reserve ≤ 0.80) for detecting hemodynamically significant coronary artery stenosis in stable chest pain?

In postmenopausal women with hormone receptor-positive (HR+), HER2-negative advanced breast cancer, does the addition of a CDK4/6 inhibitor to endocrine therapy compared with endocrine monotherapy prolong progression-free survival (PFS)?

In adults with resectable stage II-III non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), does neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy compared with neoadjuvant chemotherapy alone improve the pathological complete response (pCR) rate at time of surgery?
In patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC), does an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI) compared with docetaxel chemotherapy improve overall survival?

In adults with microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) or mismatch repair-deficient (dMMR) metastatic colorectal cancer, does first-line pembrolizumab compared with standard chemotherapy (mFOLFOX6 or FOLFIRI) ± targeted therapy improve progression-free survival?

In patients with acute ischemic stroke caused by large vessel occlusion in the anterior circulation within 6–24 hours of last known well, does endovascular thrombectomy plus standard medical care compared with medical care alone improve functional independence at 90 days?

In adults with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS), do high-efficacy disease-modifying therapies (DMTs) used as first-line treatment compared with an escalating treatment strategy reduce the annualized relapse rate at 2 years?
In adults with chronic migraine ($ \ge $15 headache days/month), do monoclonal antibodies targeting the CGRP pathway compared with topiramate reduce monthly migraine days at 24 weeks?

In patients with early-stage Parkinson's disease experiencing motor fluctuations, does an MAO-B inhibitor compared with a dopamine agonist as adjunct therapy to levodopa reduce daily "off" time at 12 months?

In infants under 12 months old hospitalized with acute bronchiolitis, does nebulized hypertonic saline (3%) compared with standard nebulized normal saline (0.9%) shorten the length of hospital stay?

In children aged 2–18 years with mild-to-moderate acute asthma exacerbations, does a short course of oral dexamethasone (1–2 days) compared with standard oral prednisolone (3–5 days) reduce emergency department return rates within 7 days?

In neonates born at ≥36 weeks' gestation with moderate-to-severe hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy, does therapeutic hypothermia initiated within 6 hours of birth compared with normothermia reduce death or disability at 18–24 months?

In very preterm infants ($<$32 weeks' gestation), does early prophylactic administration of oral or IV probiotics compared with placebo or no treatment reduce the incidence of Stage ≥2 necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC)?

In adults with treatment-resistant depression, does adjunctive intravenous ketamine/esketamine infusion compared with an active control (intravenous midazolam) achieve higher clinical remission rates at 24 hours?

In adults with moderate-to-severe major depressive disorder, does Internet-delivered cognitive behavioral therapy (iCBT) compared with face-to-face CBT achieve non-inferior reductions in depressive symptoms at 12 weeks?

In adults with schizophrenia experiencing an acute relapse, do second-generation antipsychotic long-acting injectables (LAIs) compared with equivalent oral second-generation antipsychotics reduce psychiatric rehospitalization over 12 months?

In adults with generalized anxiety disorder (GAD), does a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) compared with a serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI) offer superior efficacy and tolerability over 8–12 weeks?

[Prognostic] Is a history of childhood trauma (physical, emotional, or sexual abuse), compared with no history of trauma, a predictor of poor treatment response to first-line pharmacotherapy in adults with major depressive disorder?

In adults presenting to the emergency department with acute undifferentiated hypotension, does a point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) diagnostic protocol compared with standard clinical assessment alone reduce 30-day mortality?

In adults with acute severe behavioral disturbance or agitation in the emergency department, does intramuscular ketamine compared with intramuscular midazolam combined with haloperidol reduce the time to adequate sedation?

In adults with suspected acute pulmonary embolism who are hemodynamically stable, does the use of the YEARS criteria clinical decision rule compared with the standard Wells score/revised Geneva score safely reduce the rate of CT pulmonary angiography (CTPA) ordering?

[Diagnostic] What is the diagnostic accuracy of a single high-sensitivity cardiac troponin T (hs-cTnT) level below the limit of detection at presentation compared with serial troponin testing for ruling out acute myocardial infarction in the ED?
In hospitalized adults with severe sepsis or septic shock, does a restricted fluid resuscitation strategy compared with a liberal fluid strategy reduce 30-day all-cause mortality?

In hospitalized patients with Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI), does first-line oral fidaxomicin compared with oral vancomycin increase the rate of sustained clinical response at 30 days post-treatment?

In patients with confirmed Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia, does early switching to oral antibiotic therapy compared with continuing an all-intravenous course affect clinical success at 90 days?

In adults with obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and co-existing cardiovascular disease, does continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) therapy compared with standard lifestyle advice reduce the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events at 2 years?
